content.body: The M3A1 Grease Gun is an iconic submachine gun used by the Allied forces. It was cheap to make and effective. Though it had a slower rate of fire than most smg's it was very reliable and the barrel could be changed out to use 9mm rounds.
content.brief: WEAPON: M3A1 Grease Gun SMG AMMO: .45 cal Auto Colt Pistol (ACP) MAGAZINE: 30 round MUZZLE VELOCITY: 280 m/s RATE OF FIRE: 450 rpm OTHER EQUIPMENT: M1911A1 Automatic Pistol .45 cal Mk II HE Grenades (4) M8 Smoke Grenades (2) Combat Knife
content.title: Submachine Gunner
